maverick2022_kv_density.authors: Emily E. Maverick and Michael M. Tamkun
maverick2022_kv_density.preparation: Tagged Kv channels in HEK293 cells at room temperature. The flipped potassium solutions contained 150 mM external and 30 mM internal K+, with a theoretical reversal of +41.2 mV.
maverick2022_kv_density.observable: Channels estimated to conduct divided by channels estimated from gating charge. The authors used ionic slope conductance and gating charge in the same cells, fluorescence to calibrate gating charge per channel, and current fluctuations to estimate unitary conductance and open probability.
maverick2022_kv_density.mean_locator: Results and Fig. 8B. The text gives fractions. Fig. 8B and 8C use fraction axes. The caption appends a percent sign to the printed decimal fractions.
maverick2022_kv_density.density_locator: Fig. 8C, p. 766. Approximate axis readings of the first and last orange triangles in the authors' three-cell moving average, rounded to about 5 channels/µm² and 0.01 fraction. No pointwise uncertainty is printed.
maverick2022_kv_density.interpretation: The density series compares groups of cells. It can challenge a constant conducting fraction across expression densities. Testing absolute signed current requires the conductance and state at the specified voltage.
